name: Invoice
subject: Invoice {{invoice.number}} from {{company.name}}
description: Professional B2B invoice template with company details, itemized billing, and payment instructions.
useCase: Send to customers/clients with invoice details. Used for billing, subscription renewals, one-time purchases, and service invoices. Suitable for B2B and B2C transactions.
customizationGuide: Update company details in header. Create line items for your products/services. Add payment instructions specific to your payment methods. Customize due date and totals. Include correct tax calculations.
complianceNotes: Invoice includes: Company information, invoice number and date, itemized breakdown, tax details, payment instructions, and contact information. Suitable for tax and accounting compliance.
